title: Close to Thee
description: Close to Thee in Tonic Solfa to CLOSE TO THEE: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Fanny Crosby wrote the words, published in 1874 with the tune CLOSE TO THEE by Silas J. Vail.
underlay: Thou my ev-er-last-ing por-tion, More than friend or life to me, All a-long my pil-grim jour-ney, Sa-viour, let me walk with Thee. Close to Thee, close to Thee, Close to Thee, close to Thee; All a-long my pil-grim jour-ney, Sa-viour, let me walk with Thee.

lines: More than friend or life to me,
Saviour, let me walk with Thee.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Close to Thee, close to Thee,
Close to Thee, close to Thee;
Saviour, let me walk with Thee.
Not for ease or worldly pleasure,
Nor for fame my prayer shall be;
Gladly will I toil and suffer,
Only let me walk with Thee.
Lead me through the vale of shadows,
Bear me o’er life’s fitful sea;
Then the gate of life eternal
May I enter, Lord, with Thee.
